tokens.name: harbor
tokens.usage: Brand primary. Nav, footer, headings, hero bands, links. 13:1 on white. The color people should remember the brand by.

tokens.name: corten
tokens.usage: Accent, named after weathering steel. Primary CTA (Build Your Home, Check Financing) and at most one highlight per screen. Never body text, never backgrounds bigger than a button.

tokens.name: on-corten
tokens.usage: Text and icons on corten buttons. 5.3:1 light, 5.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: live-oak
tokens.usage: Secondary. Financing prequal, success states, checkmarks in included-features lists. 7.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Warm tint for price badges and callouts sitting on harbor (7.3:1). Never as text on white.

tokens.name: galvanized
tokens.usage: Page background. Cool steel grey, not cream.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on galvanized and surface. 14:1 light, 13:1 dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, helper text, spec labels. 5.9:1 light, 7.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default. Cards, images, inputs. Containers have hard corners, so does the brand.
